claim: A compiled UI script at its own entry in a movie pack (ui_scale_<tag>x.pack) replaces the vanilla script: no dev.file_rules line is needed. With the dev bridge on at 2x, wsp.vanilla returns that patched copy of a wrapped script, so the harness and a play install run the same bytes
notes: run 2026-11-05_j67pc: ui/huds.luac (not wrapped) moved the battle radar group to the top-right corner on the first launch; probes/wsp_copy.lua read ui\battle ui\root.luac through wsp.vanilla at 2x: 76 present, 38 absent. See napoleon.ui.dev_wrapper_lost_at_fractional for 1.25x and 1.5x
